g.text: Dependency review — each page checked against the pages it leans on
1. pull out pictures and sum up each page
no picture, so it goes straight to summary
no picture, so it goes straight to summary
2. work out which page leans on which (every summary goes into every check)
leans on nothing (it's the base page)
leans on: how to drive a car
leans on: how to drive a car
3. review each page with the pages it leans on
says "turn the key to start", but the driving
page it leans on says the car starts
one review per page. Shown here for the motorway page; the off-road page is reviewed the same way against the driving page.
